title: Modern Heavy Duty (Ideal Routine)
author: DeDe
desc:
Rest Days: 48-72hrs minimum in between every training day. Very Important as Recovery is key to GROWTH.

Warm-ups: Perform a few light, progressive warm-up sets. These do not count toward your workout volume.

The Working Set: You perform exactly one working set to absolute momentary muscular failure per listed exercise. 

Rep Cadence: Use a strict, ultra-controlled cadence. Mentzer favored a 4-second concentric (lifting), 2-second hold at peak contraction, and 4-second eccentric (lowering) phase. This eliminates all momentum.

Rep Range: Aim for 6 to 10 reps to failure. If you can get 10 clean reps, increase the weight by 10% for the next workout.
